description: Window controls, tray, zoom and notifications for the remote dsh page, which is where the injected title bar lives - so that page's own origin has to be allowed to invoke them. Scoped to loopback: this is where the dsh web server binds, and dsh refuses any other host, so a dsh page served from elsewhere gets no title bar rather than a window it should not control. Four window commands, one tray command, one zoom command, two self-diagnosis commands, and the three notification commands the notification plugin's injected shim calls. No fs, shell, clipboard or path access.
